content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Could anyone suggest how to set [product_name] to RUN or STOP mode? Thanks. Best regards, [user_name]

In the main menu, choose RUN to start [product_name]. 1. Go to the main menu: Press ESC 2. Move the cursor to 'Start' 3. Confirm 'Start': Press OK Once running, the device will execute the program and display a confirmation screen. Details can be found in the manual, which is available at [url]
Alternatively, consult the manual for instructions.
For models without a display, you can use [product_name] software to set the mode, or power off, unplug the programming cable, then turn the device back on.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for clear instructions on switching [product_name] between RUN and STOP modes. There is confusion regarding the process, especially differentiating between devices with and without screens. Referring to manuals and menu navigation can be challenging for users unfamiliar with the different hardware types.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect easy-to-follow, accessible directions for setting [product_name] to RUN or STOP mode, whether operating versions with a display or not.
